## Análisis Completo de Datos

```{r analisis-completo, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. SETUP Y GENERACIÓN DE DATOS
# ==============================================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(moments)

set.seed(42)
n <- 5000

build_time_min <- round(rgamma(n, shape = 5, rate = 0.5), 2)
deploy_time_min <- round(rnorm(n, mean = 8, sd = 2.5), 2)
deploy_time_min <- ifelse(deploy_time_min < 0.5, 0.5, deploy_time_min) 
test_coverage_pct <- round(runif(n, min = 45.0, max = 99.9), 2)
ticket_resolution_h <- round(rgamma(n, shape = 2, rate = 0.1), 2)

commit_size_loc <- rpois(n, lambda = 120)
num_bugs <- rpois(n, lambda = 1.5)

team <- sample(c("Equipo_1", "Equipo_2", "Equipo_3", "Equipo_4", "Equipo_5"), n, replace = TRUE)
module <- sample(c("Auth", "Payments", "Dashboard", "API", "Database"), n, replace = TRUE)
deploy_status <- sample(c("Success", "Failed", "Rolled_Back"), n, replace = TRUE, 
                        prob = c(0.85, 0.10, 0.05))

priority_levels <- c("Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical")
priority <- factor(
  sample(priority_levels, n, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.4, 0.4, 0.15, 0.05)), 
  levels = priority_levels, 
  ordered = TRUE
)

devops_data <- data.frame(
  build_time_min, deploy_time_min, commit_size_loc, num_bugs,
  test_coverage_pct, ticket_resolution_h, team, module, priority, deploy_status
)

write.csv(devops_data, file = "devops_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Archivo 'devops_metrics.csv' generado con éxito con", nrow(devops_data), "filas.\n\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. LIMPIEZA E INSPECCIÓN
# ==============================================================================
devops_data <- read_csv("devops_metrics.csv")

cat("--- Estructura inicial (Glimpse) ---\n")
glimpse(devops_data)

cat("\n--- Resumen estadístico (Summary) ---\n")
summary(devops_data)

cat("\n--- Conteo de valores nulos ---\n")
print(colSums(is.na(devops_data)))

devops_data <- devops_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    team = factor(team, levels = c("Equipo_1", "Equipo_2", "Equipo_3", "Equipo_4", "Equipo_5")),
    priority = factor(priority, levels = c("Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical"), ordered = TRUE)
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 3. ESTADÍSTICA DESCRIPTIVA Y FRECUENCIAS
# ==============================================================================
analisis_build_time <- devops_data |>
  summarise(
    media = mean(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    mediana = median(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    desviacion_estandar = sd(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    coeficiente_variacion = (sd(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE)) * 100,
    rango_intercuartilico = IQR(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    asimetria = skewness(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    curtosis = kurtosis(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat("\n--- Análisis Estadístico: build_time_min ---\n")
print(analisis_build_time)

k_sturges <- round(1 + 3.322 * log10(nrow(devops_data)))
tabla_frecuencias <- devops_data |>
  mutate(clase_build_time = cut(build_time_min, breaks = k_sturges, include.lowest = TRUE)) |>
  group_by(clase_build_time) |>
  summarise(frec_absoluta = n()) |>
  mutate(
    frec_relativa = frec_absoluta / sum(frec_absoluta),
    frec_acumulada = cumsum(frec_absoluta),
    frec_relativa_acumulada = cumsum(frec_relativa)
  )

cat("\n--- Tabla de Frecuencias (Regla de Sturges k =", k_sturges, ") ---\n")
print(tabla_frecuencias)

comparacion_equipos <- devops_data |>
  group_by(team) |>
  summarise(
    mediana_build_time = median(build_time_min, na.rm = TRUE),
    promedio_bugs = mean(num_bugs, na.rm = TRUE),
    tasa_fallos_pct = mean(deploy_status == "Failed", na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(tasa_fallos_pct))

cat("\n--- Comparación por Equipos ---\n")
print(comparacion_equipos)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. CORRELACIONES
# ==============================================================================
matriz_correlacion <- devops_data |>
  select(where(is.numeric)) |>
  cor(use = "complete.obs")

cat("\n--- Matriz de Correlación Completa ---\n")
print(round(matriz_correlacion, 3))

cat("\n--- Tabla de Contingencia (Proporciones en %) ---\n")
print(round(prop.table(table(devops_data$priority, devops_data$deploy_status)) * 100, 2))

# ==============================================================================
# 5. GRÁFICOS GGPLOT2
# ==============================================================================
histograma_build <- ggplot(devops_data, aes(x = build_time_min)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "#3498db", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Distribución del Tiempo de Compilación", x = "Tiempo (Minutos)", y = "Frecuencia") +
  theme_minimal()

boxplot_tickets <- ggplot(devops_data, aes(x = team, y = ticket_resolution_h)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#3498db", alpha = 0.7, outlier.color = "red", outlier.size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Tiempo de Resolución de Tickets por Equipo", x = "Equipo", y = "Horas") +
  theme_minimal() 

barras_prioridad <- ggplot(devops_data, aes(x = priority)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#3498db", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Despliegues por Prioridad", x = "Prioridad", y = "Cantidad") +
  theme_minimal()

dispersion_bugs <- ggplot(devops_data, aes(x = commit_size_loc, y = num_bugs)) +
  geom_point(color = "#3498db", alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Tamaño del Commit vs Bugs", x = "Líneas de Código", y = "Bugs") +
  theme_minimal()

print(histograma_build)
print(boxplot_tickets)
print(barras_prioridad)
print(dispersion_bugs)
